documentation_excerpts.text: Signal diagnostics, statistical validation, and backtest evaluation for quantitative trading workflows.

Use `ml4t-diagnostic` to evaluate cross-sectional signals, construct purged time-series validation folds, correct strategy statistics for selection bias, analyze feature and trade behavior, and produce backtest reports.
`ml4t-diagnostic` is one of seven libraries supporting the workflow described in [Machine Learning for Trading](https://www.ml4trading.io/).
